exceptions.mitigation: The package is reachable only through the local MCP Inspector CLI and the demo's build-time ESLint/checker graph; Better Convex exposes no user-controlled glob interface, repository tooling supplies the inputs, and shipped runtime plus standalone starter production audits exclude this development-only graph.
exceptions.reason: Upstream published the memory-bound fix only in the API-incompatible 5.x line. The official MCP Inspector CLI and demo build tooling still resolve minimatch 3 / brace-expansion 1, so forcing 5.x would break those callers; retain the exact development tools until their upstream graphs adopt a compatible patched release.

exceptions.mitigation: The exact clean Nuxt consumer reaches this package only through Nitro 2.13.4's Azure deployment archive builder. Nitro invokes archiver.glob with the constant pattern **/* over its generated output directory; the dependency is absent from the generated server runtime, Better Convex accepts no glob pattern, and no request or application value can influence the pattern.
exceptions.reason: Nitro 2.13.4 pins archiver to the incompatible ^7.0.1 line, while the first dependency chain using a patched brace-expansion is archiver 8. Requiring a consumer-only package-manager override would make npm certification dishonest. Retain this exact non-runtime dependency only until Nitro adopts a compatible patched archiver graph.
